label.label: Field label
label._note: Renders as <label class="sgs-form-field__label"> — no per-instance colour/font-size/weight attribute exists on this block; the label is styled entirely by shared framework CSS across all six form-field siblings. clusters: [] is a genuine gap, not hidden — building per-field label typography/colour controls is future per-block work, not this manifest.

input.label: Textarea input
input._note: Renders as <textarea class="sgs-form-field__input">. Border, background and typography come from the form-level field settings; minimum height, padding and line height are per field (render.php prints a scoped rule on the field's uid class). `rows` is a behavioural sizing config, not a style property.

help.label: Help text
help._note:
helpText itself is field-behaviour content, not a style property (Bean's non-cluster rule) — the rendered

also carries no per-instance style attribute of its own. clusters: []. The conformance checker's orphan scanner reports helpText as an ORPHAN here (its element-key-as-fallback-prefix convention coincidentally matches help+Text); this is a known false-positive of the checker, not evidence of an unaccounted style control — helpText is intentionally content, not style, and out of scope to silence without editing the checker script.

counter.label: Character counter
counter._note: The live "0 / 800" count printed when a maximum length is set. counterPlacement chooses below the box or inside it at the bottom right; render.php prints a scoped rule on the field's uid class for the size and colour.

error.label: Error message
error._note: Populated by client-side validation JS, not a block attribute; the <span class="sgs-form-field__error"> has no per-instance style attribute. clusters: [].

counterPlacement.description: Where the character counter sits: below the box (default) or inside it at the bottom right, with room kept under the typed text.

counterReserve.description: With the counter inside the box, keep room under the typed text for it (at least 2.75rem of bottom padding). Off = reserve nothing, so the box's own bottom padding applies and the counter overlays the box.

counterFontSize.description: Font size of the character counter, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = the stylesheet's small preset size.

counterColour.description: Colour of the character counter: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = the muted text token.

inputMinHeight.description: Minimum height of the text box, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = the rows setting and the form's textarea height decide.

inputPadding.description: Padding inside the text box, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Empty = the form's field padding. With the counter inside the box the stylesheet keeps its own bottom padding.

inputLineHeight.description: Line height of the typed text: a unitless number (1.5), a length or the word normal. Empty = inherited.
